title: 2020 AMC 8 Problem 21
statement: A game board consists of \(64\) squares that alternate between shaded and unshaded. The figure below shows square \(P\) in the bottom row and square \(Q\) in the top row. A marker is placed at \(P.\) A step consists of moving the marker onto one of the adjoining unshaded squares in the row above. How many \(7\)-step paths are there from \(P\) to \(Q?\) (The figure shows a sample path.)

solutions.text:
Each move must go up one row and either left or right. Counting row by row from \(P,\) each reachable square gets the sum of the counts from the two adjoining squares below it.

The count at \(Q\) is \(28,\) so there are \(28\) paths.

Thus, the correct answer is A.
